headline.sentence: In a BESCOM outage Q-Grid cuts critical-load downtime from 2.6 h to 55 min per outage (41 L more diesel, 110 kg CO₂, to keep those loads up); on normal days the bill is 0.4% higher and the demand charge rises by Rs 16,685 a month at 1,300 kVA contract demand; with no central controller it averages 8.4% from the best possible plan against 9.2% for Per-building MPC, a lead made on the outage days (normal days: 7.4% against 0.3%).
headline.step1: Today each building acts on its own: when BESCOM supply fails, critical loads go dark for 2.6 h per outage while the diesel sets burn 373 L; the electricity bill averages Rs 177,694 a day.
